mentions.name: Capsule Agents
mentions.description: An open-source containerized agent framework built on three ideas: agents are more capable with CLI access to create and reuse scripts rather than relying solely on MCP; multi-agent setups are most effective for managing context (agent-to-agent); and agents should be easy for non-engineers to create and valuable beyond software development. The author's own instance sends a Discord message every morning with their marathon training workout and the reasoning behind it.
mentions.problem: The agent ecosystem over-relies on MCP, overvalues multi-agent setups as 'expert personas' instead of using them for context management, and is largely engineer-only and code-focused.
mentions.audience: Non-engineers who want to create and use agents beyond software development
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm still working on an open-source containerized agent framework called Capsule Agents. Some solid progress this month, getting an early version of the docs site https://capsuleagents.com live.
